critic_issues.problem: "AT teams hold fire until vehicles are in range, 300 metres." gives one range for every AT team. The GDD gives 300 m only for vehicles and Javelin. RPG range is 180 m.
critic_issues.gdd: Ranges: small arms 180, HMG 220, RPG 180, vehicles 300, Javelin 300 m; ... AT teams hold fire until vehicles are in range
critic_issues.fix: Drop the number: "AT teams hold fire until vehicles are in range."

critic_issues.problem: "Do not fire until ordered" implies a fire order. The player has only four orders: Forward, Hold, Back and Retreat.
critic_issues.gdd: the four order buttons (Forward / Hold / Back / Retreat)
critic_issues.fix: "Hold your positions. Stay in cover until contact."

critic_issues.problem: "Do not fire at the drone unless it is overhead" invents a rule about engaging drones. The GDD does not describe infantry firing at drones.
critic_issues.fix: Replace it with a line the GDD supports, e.g. "Scout drones spot for their artillery. Hold position."

critic_issues.problem: The east direction, "first light", "the ridge" and "the road" are not in the GDD excerpts. FlatTest is a flat map and the GDD says only that armour drives in from off-map. The content could contradict the shipped scene.
critic_issues.gdd: Enemy armor drives in from off-map.
critic_issues.fix: Remove the compass direction, ridge and road, or confirm them against GDD 07. Use "off the map edge" or "from the front".

critic_issues.problem: "bearing {zone}" treats a zone as a bearing. {zone} is a named area, not a direction.
Lines 1–2 read as a friendly vehicle loss ("Crew status unknown", "burning. Out of action"). Line 3 says "Enemy {vehicle}". One event pool mixes both perspectives.
critic_issues.fix: Make all three lines neutral, e.g. "{vehicle} destroyed at {distance} m.", or split the event by side.

critic_issues.problem: "Village Approach" implies a village. FlatTest is described as a flat test map, and the village-grid scene is parked.
critic_issues.gdd: GDD 07 describes the shipped FlatTest; the NE village-grid scene is parked
critic_issues.fix: Use a neutral title such as "Hold the Line", or confirm the village setting.

briefing.title: Hold the Line: Village Approach
lines: Company commander. Enemy assault expected at first light from the east.
Three rifle squads, one drone team and one vehicle hold the line.
Two waves: infantry first, then armour and mechanized infantry.
Stay concealed through the bombardment. Save anti-tank and drones for armour.
If they break into the deployment zone, the battle is lost.

Intel: HQ to all stations: enemy forces approaching from the east. Stay concealed.
Recon reports vehicle movement beyond the ridge. Expect two waves.
Hold your positions. Do not fire until ordered or until contact.
Scouting: Enemy scout drone over the line. Keep your heads down.
Drone reveals at 150 metres. Units in cover stay hidden until they fire.
Do not fire at the drone unless it is overhead. Hold position.
Bombardment: Artillery on revealed positions. Stay in cover and hold.
Expect strikes on any unit they marked. Do not move into the open.
Shelling will lift soon. Be ready for the advance.
VehicleAdvance: Armour on the road from the east. Save anti-tank and drones for them.
Rifles will not hurt heavy armour. Use AT teams and drones.
AT teams hold fire until vehicles are in range, 300 metres.
MechanizedInfantry: Transports stopping short of the line. Infantry will dismount and advance.
They unload at 300 to 600 metres. Drones can reach them there.
Hold the line. Do not let them into the deployment zone.

squad_lost: {squad} wiped out in {zone}. Line is thinner.
vehicle_destroyed: {vehicle} hit and burning. Out of action.
transport_unloading: Transport unloading at {distance} m. Infantry dismounting.
{count} enemy troops out of the transport at {zone}.

output.routing_message: The enemy is routing — victory is near.

critic_issues.problem: The briefing says 'infantry first, then armour and mechanized infantry'. The phase radio runs VehicleAdvance (armour) before MechanizedInfantry, and Intel says 'Expect two waves'. A player could read the armour-first phase order as clashing with the infantry-first briefing.
critic_issues.gdd: Order of phases 4–5 (decided by Noah 2026-11-05): armour leads once transports carry infantry (tickets N180 → N182); until then the prototype's infantry-first pacing stands. / FlatTest fields two fixed waves (infantry at t+0, armour and mechanized infantry at t+120 s)
critic_issues.fix: Reword the briefing to match the phase sequence the player will see, e.g. 'Two waves: infantry first, then armour with mechanized infantry.' Keep the phase radio as it is.

critic_issues.problem: Both lines say the battle is lost if the line fails ('Your line holds or the battle is lost' and 'If they break into the deployment zone, the battle is lost'). Line 0 is vague filler.
critic_issues.gdd: Defeat the moment an enemy unit breaks through into the player's deployment zone, or when all player forces are dead
critic_issues.fix: Replace line 0 with a concrete objective, e.g. 'Destroy or break the assault. Hold the line until they rout.' Keep line 4 for the defeat condition and add 'or all forces are lost'.

critic_issues.problem: It says units in cover 'stay hidden until they fire'. That is only one of three reveal triggers, so it can mislead.
critic_issues.gdd: Infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy comes within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them; the enemy scout drone reveals within 150 m
critic_issues.fix: e.g. 'Scout drone reveals at 150 m. Units in cover stay hidden until they fire or enemy is within 100 m.' (≤ 90 chars)

critic_issues.problem: 'Hold your positions', 'Hold position' and 'Stay in cover and hold' repeat across the first three phases with little new information. 'Shelling will lift soon' (Bombardment[2]) is vague and promises timing the GDD does not specify.
critic_issues.fix: Give each phase a distinct, actionable line, e.g. Scouting: 'Do not fire until ordered, or you reveal yourselves.' Replace 'will lift soon' with 'Expect armour when shelling ends.'

critic_issues.problem: 'Enemy {enemy} spotted' may read 'Enemy Enemy BMP-3M' if {enemy} already carries the faction. '{count} vehicles remain' does not say whose vehicles. '{unit} drone hit. Target destroyed.' is awkward and does not say what was hit.
critic_issues.fix: Use 'Contact: {enemy} at {distance} m in {zone}.' Use '{vehicle} knocked out. {count} enemy vehicles remain.' Use '{unit} drone hit {enemy}. Target destroyed.'

deterministic_issues: schema: $.phase_radio.Scouting[1]: 'Scout drone reveals at 150 m. Units in cover stay hidden until they fire or enemy is within 100 m.' is too long

critic_issues.problem: The line is about 98 characters long, which is over the 90-character limit for HQ radio lines. It is also a rules recital, not terse radio voice.
critic_issues.gdd: Infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy comes within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them; the enemy scout drone reveals within 150 m
critic_issues.fix: Split or shorten it, e.g. "Scout drone reveals out to 150 m. Hold fire in cover." Put the 100 m trigger in a separate line or drop it.

critic_issues.problem: The Bombardment line says "Expect armour when shelling ends". The briefing says "Two waves: infantry first, then armour with mechanized infantry". The GDD says the prototype keeps infantry-first pacing until transports carry infantry, so armour does not necessarily follow the bombardment. The phase lines then run VehicleAdvance before MechanizedInfantry, which also clashes with the briefing's "armour with mechanized infantry".
critic_issues.gdd: In the prototype FlatTest fields two fixed waves (infantry at t+0, armour and mechanized infantry at t+120 s) ... armour leads once transports carry infantry (tickets N180 → N182); until then the prototype's infantry-first pacing stands.
critic_issues.fix: Reword Bombardment[2] so it does not promise armour next, e.g. "Expect contact when the shelling lifts. Keep anti-tank teams ready." Make the briefing and phase wording agree on the wave order.

critic_issues.problem: "Do not fire until ordered" invents an order or fire-control rule. The GDD only says units in cover stay concealed until they fire. There is no "ordered fire" mechanic, and the line may mislead the player.
critic_issues.gdd: Infantry in cover stay concealed until they fire, an enemy comes within 100 m, or a recon drone spots them
critic_issues.fix: Use "Hold fire in cover. Firing reveals your position."

critic_issues.problem: "{vehicle} knocked out. {count} enemy vehicles remain." fits only an enemy vehicle kill. If {vehicle} is the player's vehicle, the line reads wrongly.
critic_issues.fix: Use "{vehicle} knocked out. {count} vehicles left in contact." or split into separate enemy and own-vehicle lines.

critic_issues.problem: "Hold the line until the enemy routs" implies victory comes at the rout. The GDD says victory comes only after every routing unit has left the map edge. The line also reads as an objective statement, not a commander's briefing.
critic_issues.gdd: victory is declared when every routing unit has left the map edge
critic_issues.fix: Use "Destroy or break the assault. Hold until the routing enemy has left the map."

critic_issues.problem: "Drone strike on target. {enemy} hit." is vague and close to the third line. The three lines say nearly the same thing.
critic_issues.fix: Vary the content, e.g. "Drone hit on {enemy} at {distance} m."

critic_issues.problem: "Keep your heads down" is colloquial. It is not a terse modern-military radio phrase.
critic_issues.fix: Use "Enemy scout drone over the line. Stay in cover."
